title: Boundary point classes commute with field extension
statement: Let k and k' be algebraically closed fields with a k-algebra structure on k' [def-sc-field-extension], let f:C to Spec k be a smooth affine connected curve [def-sc-curves], and let c be a smooth connected compactification [lem-sc-compactification] of relative dimension one before and after base change [lemma-nagata-compactification-base-change]. There is a bijection between the boundary closed points of c.Z and those of its base change, such that Picard pullback [def-sc-picard-group] sends the class O(P) [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle] to the class O(e(P)). No boundary base point or boundary subgroup is chosen.

source.place: Affine case, compactification/boundary and final compatibility paragraphs; expanded from the proof recorded in lem-sc-pic-affine-base-change-compatibility

proof.text: The compactification is a smooth connected, hence integral, noetherian curve. Its nonempty open C is dense; its closed complement is zero-dimensional and finite. All closed boundary points have residue field k by finite type and algebraic closedness. Their base changes are Spec k prime. The cartesian open-immersion square identifies the new complement with precisely these disjoint singleton fibres. This gives a bijection of boundary closed points, including the empty and singleton cases.

The projection is flat since it is the base change of a field extension. The effective Cartier ideal of a rational point pulls back to the ideal of its singleton reduced fibre. Flat pullback of the dual invertible ideal identifies the line bundles O(P) and the new point line bundle. Passage to Picard classes gives the displayed equality for every boundary point.

theorem boundary_point_class_base_change
    {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [Field k'] [Algebra k k'] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed k']
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C]
    (c : Compactification f) [IsConnectedCurve c.g] [Smooth c.g]
    [hsm : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 c.g]
    [hsm' : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).g]
    : let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))
      let c' := c.baseChange b
      ∃ e : {P : closedPoints c.Z // P.val ∉ Set.range c.i.base} ≃
          {Q : closedPoints c'.Z // Q.val ∉ Set.range c'.i.base},
        ∀ P, Scheme.Pic.mapHom (pullback.fst c.g b)
          (@Scheme.Pic.ofClosedPoint k _ c.Z ⟨c.g⟩ hsm P.val) =
          @Scheme.Pic.ofClosedPoint k' _ c'.Z ⟨c'.g⟩ hsm' (e P).val
